bible_refs: EMAIL-009 house style (Alder signatory Tom Reyes; Sacramento offices)
rationale: Two separate Alder APP-OPT option agreements with Clearwater Land LLC (Owner/Optionor; managing member signs, per EMAIL-1402) for the two adjoining Route 97 parcels walked 3/22/22 (EMAIL-1409): KW-01 = north parcel (open ground, county-road frontage); KW-02 = south parcel (county road + ranch track, so the executed copy includes a ranch-track access easement across Owner's north land). The old unreleased grazing lease (1402/1407/1409/1410) becomes a disclosed title item with release mechanics. KW-01 v1 (3/29/22) has blanks because Hannah's county-filing request (1410-1412) was still outstanding. Version history follows the carrier bodies: KW-01 is drafted slowly (v1 3/29, v2 7/5 filled from filings, v3 9/14 owner-counsel comments, v4 12/19 closing window 60->90 per EMAIL-397) and executed 1/10/23; KW-02 has v1 5/6/22, v2 9/9/22 (owner-counsel comments + access), and was executed 9/20/22. All dates are after 3/16/22. Money: Option Fee $12,000 per parcel (matches KW ledger stubs), payable as three $4,000 installments (a proposed split of the $12,000). Optionee may defer any installment after the first (Sec. 3.3), may prepay (3.4), and may extend the 12-month term once by 6 months (2.2). That permits option payments after the application date (EMAIL-140) without explaining them: no recital, clause or schedule links payments to applications, and the drafts contain no application references, as the carrier bodies say. $1,150 per Net Acre is a proposed purchase price. It is never multiplied out, and acreage of record (148.62 / 111.87 ac) is stated for identification only, with price set on surveyed Net Acreage. The document states no supported-vs-claimed acreage. Attachment choice follows the email BODY parcel, not the subject. 2022 carriers get the draft current on their date. 2023 collection and record copies to counsel/Whitaker/Alder get the executed scan (KW-02 exec 9/20/22; KW-01 exec 1/10/23), except 423 (v2) and 436 (v1), where counsel is assembling the KW-02 draft history. Those two bodies say 'option draft', so a draft fits.
